shared_elements: human or humanoid figure with visible arms/hands
snake-like elongated body with incised/hatched surface
hatched or netted band of pattern
stacked vertical arrangement of figures on an upright monolith
animal positioned above/over a human figure
justification: Both surfaces present an upright monolith carrying a vertically stacked sequence in which big-headed animals occupy the upper zone directly above small schematic human figures with visible arms and hands, and both include an elongated hatched serpentine body and areas of net/hatch infill, a fairly specific combination. The main difference is the mode of depiction and content detail: A is a flat multi-register relief with distinct bands of birds, quadrupeds and a pattern strip read as a frieze, whereas B is a three-dimensional composite in which a single predator-headed creature is fused over a frontal human head, without registers or bird imagery.
